summary: Frontend-only testing for drag coordinate fix implementation. Verified: 1) App loads correctly with Czech UI, 2) Modules add via toolbar, 3) Projects module navigates into ProjectWorldModule correctly, 4) Elements can be added to project canvas. Drag behavior could not be fully tested via Playwright due to React state management, but code review confirms implementation is correct.
critical_code_review_comments: DraggableModule.jsx: Correctly uses getLocalPointer for coordinate conversion and 2px activation threshold to prevent jump on drag start
ProjectWorldModule.jsx: ProjectItem component also uses getLocalPointer helper with same 2px threshold pattern
dragUtils.js: getLocalPointer correctly accounts for CSS transforms by comparing rect.width to offsetWidth
WorkspaceContext.js (lines 355-423): getSnapLayouts correctly implements 30px SNAP_GAP between left-half and right-half layouts
WorkspaceContext.js (line 377): rightSnapX = safeZone.left + leftSnapWidth + SNAP_GAP ensures 30px gap when both sides snapped

success_rate.frontend: 100% for UI loading and module operations

seed_data_creation: Used existing seed projects: Web Redesign (75%), Mobile App (45%), API Integration (100%)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Drag behavior testing via Playwright is challenging due to React state management. Manual testing recommended for drag-related features. The code implementation looks correct based on review.

features_tested.feature: Window drag - no jump on start
features_tested.details: DraggableModule.jsx uses dragStateRef with 2px threshold before activating drag. getLocalPointer helper ensures consistent coordinate conversion. Playwright couldn't reliably trigger React drag state.

features_tested.feature: Window snap to left edge with 30px margin
features_tested.details: getSnapLayouts() returns left-half layout with position.x = safeZone.left (30px margin). SNAP_THRESHOLD=50 triggers when cursor x < 50.

features_tested.feature: Window snap to right edge with 30px gap between windows
features_tested.details: getSnapLayouts() calculates: leftSnapWidth = (safeWidth - 30) / 2, rightSnapX = safeZone.left + leftSnapWidth + 30. This ensures 30px gap between left and right snapped windows.
ProjectItem component in ProjectWorldModule.jsx uses same getLocalPointer helper and 2px threshold pattern. Consistent implementation.
Successfully added Notes, Files, Projects modules. Toast notifications work. Module count badge updates.
Can open Projects module, click Otevřít on project, navigate into ProjectWorldModule, add elements via FAB menu.

getLocalPointer_helper.purpose: Converts mouse clientX/clientY to local container coordinates, accounting for CSS transforms
getLocalPointer_helper.implementation: Calculates scaleX/scaleY from rect vs offset dimensions, applies inverse transform to client coords

drag_threshold.purpose: 2px movement threshold before activating drag to prevent jump
drag_threshold.implementation: dragStateRef stores initial pointer position, drag only activates after dx+dy >= 2

snap_gap_30px.implementation: SNAP_GAP=30, usableWidth = safeWidth - 30, split equally between left/right with gap in middle

mocked_apis_note: Entire app uses localStorage for persistence - no backend API calls
